name: Haus St. Christina
beschreibung: The Haus St. Christina enjoys a sunny and quiet setting in Ried im Oberinntal, nestled in the heart of the Tyrolean Oberland. The spacious holiday apartments are tastefully decorated in an alpine style, featuring fully equipped kitchens for independent self-catering, separate bedrooms, satellite TV, Wi-Fi, and sunny balconies with lovely mountain panoramas. After an active day in the fresh alpine air, guests can unwind in the property's sauna area. Ried's town centre, featuring supermarkets, local restaurants, and the popular Lake Ried swimming area, is easily reached on foot. In winter, complimentary ski buses quickly transport guests to the vast ski expanses of Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis and Fendels. In summer, the Inn cycle route and high-altitude hiking trails delight nature lovers.
kurzbeschreibung: Cosy holiday apartments in Ried im Oberinntal with sunny balconies, sauna amenities, and close to the Fiss-Ladis lifts.
